answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before accepting paid work. The stake returns after a clean record, but is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities or selling the same output twice. One operator fanning a plume of fake agents must fund every copy, so the cost of the attack grows with its size while honest agents get their deposit back in full. A public harbor of verified identities, transparent as quartz, lets anyone check that cost before assigning a job.
